description: This file defines the MapStack class, a specialized stack of Map objects used for managing nested contexts within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating, copying, and managing context stacks, with special handling for a 'context' key.

classes.name: MapStack
classes.description: A class extending MapContext that manages a stack of Map objects for context management within OFBiz.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new MapStack instance, optionally initialized with a base Map or copying from another MapStack.

methods.name: standAloneStack
methods.description: Returns a new MapStack sharing the same Map objects, for parent-child context sharing.

methods.name: standAloneChildStack
methods.description: Returns a new MapStack with a new Map pushed on top, sharing the same underlying Maps.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overrides Map get method to return the MapStack itself when key is 'context'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overloaded method to get a value with locale support, returning the MapStack itself for 'context'.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Overrides Map put method to log a warning if 'context' key is used with a value different from the MapStack itself.
